newsitem.title: USA: US OPTIONS FOCUS/Arakis Energy up on possible deal.
newsitem.headline: US OPTIONS FOCUS/Arakis Energy up on possible deal.

text.p: A little-traded option, with only an October series, topped the most actives list on the Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) Tuesday as the stock rallied on heavy volume.
By 1415 CDT (1915 GMT), shares of Canada's Arakis Energy Corp were up 1 at 4-1/4 on volume of more than 19 million. The stock reached 4-3/4 intraday.
Earlier on Tuesday, the company said it was drawing close to a possible deal with joint venture partners for the development of its oil concession in Sudan.
A trader at the CBOE said speculators were betting the deal would soon close.
The Arakis October five call traded 7,350 contracts and the October 7-1/2 call traded 5,860.
The October five call had open interest of roughly 24,200 and the October 7-1/2 call had open interest of 12,120.
The trader at the CBOE said there were buyers and sellers of the October five call and a professional trader selling the bulk of the October 7-1/2.
The Arakis October five put traded 268 contracts and the October 7-1/2 put traded 10.
"If the stock closes at four or above, we get to add on the rest of the series," the trader at the CBOE said.
"A lot of people were worried it was going to delist," he said. "But with a new series, it will remain popular."
In other trading, options on technology stocks were active amid a pickup in volatility in the sector.

Among the stocks with busy options, International Business Machines Corp was up 1-3/8 at 129-1/4, Intel Corp was off 1-7/8 at 102-7/8, Motorola Inc fell 1-1/8 to 48-5/8 and Micron Technology Inc was up 5/8 at 31-7/8 after hitting 33.
